title: Mistral Ware onramp — ops sticky notes
content:
Context:
- 2025-02-18 call with Mistral Ware (ops + infra leads). They're a mid-market logistics SW vendor (EU + NA) wanting local inference for sensitive telemetry enrichment and agent-assist features. Two main use cases: realtime route summarization (streaming chat-like responses) and nightly batch embeddings for analytics.

Customer constraints / non-negotiables:
- No model traffic leaving their VPC (must be Private deployment, air-gapped optional).
- KMS + HSM integration required for key lifecycle (YubiHSM as preferred vendor).
- Audit retention: 90 days request/response logs (redactable), plus token-level cost telemetry retained 1 year (aggregated).
- SLA expectation: P99 latency <= 1200ms for short chat requests (<= 256 tokens); sustained QPS up to 30 for peak windows.
- Throughput for batch embeddings: 500k vectors nightly (embedding size TBD).

Initial technical notes (rough):
- Proposed topology: Private control plane in our cloud + on-prem inference nodes (k8s cluster) inside customer VPC with egress blocked. Control plane connects over customer-approved management channel (mutual TLS).
- Model family: leaning toward open Llama-family or Mistral-7B variants; explore 7B-16k context for chat. Customer prefers smaller quantized models for cost.
- Hardware: expect 2x A10G-ish nodes for canary, scale to 6 nodes for steady-state. Need to validate GPU memory vs 16k context + kv cache.
- Batching: aggressive batching allowed for nightly embeddings; streaming chat must use continuous-batch with small max_batch latency knob (50ms) to keep p99 under 1200ms.
- Networking: internal NAT for nodes; must avoid any accidental egress to model registries. We should support local model artifacts (OCI registry mirror inside VPC).

Gotchas / flagged follow-ups from call:
- KMS workflow: customer uses AWS KMS for most things but their HSMs for signing. We need to confirm Redwood Private supports external HSM signing hooks (not just KMS). Ticket created (JIRA-4827).
- Audit requirement ambiguous: they want request/response redaction for PII. Need to surface how our redaction pipeline works for streaming responses vs post-hoc logs.
- Embedding storage format: they use Pinecone currently for prod, but offline analytics expects Parquet exports. Need clarity on vector dimensionality and single vs multi-embedding per doc.
- Compliance: EU data residency important — control plane endpoints must be in eu-west region for management plane interactions. Verify whether control plane location constitutes "data leaving" for legal.
- Ops access: they want SAML SCIM for user provisioning and local SSO. Also an allowlist IP range for our support tunnel. Confirm support-socket model for onprem.

Rough sizing + perf assumptions (back of envelope):
- Chat: 30 QPS peak, avg request 120 tokens in + 80 tokens out. With 7B quantized (int8/q4), expect ~1-1.5 tokens/ms with optimized kernels on A10G. Estimate 3 GPUs for steady but keep canary with 1-2.
- Embeddings: 500k vectors nightly -> if embedding model does 1.5k docs/sec per GPU (batching), approx 4-6 GPUs for windowed run (allowing retries). Can schedule as off-peak burst.
- Storage: logs + aggregated telemetry ~ 20GB/month; raw request/response retention up to 2TB depending on sampling.

Proposed minimal deliverables for POC:
1) Onprem node bootstrap script + example Helm chart (lightweight) for k8s inside customer VPC — include entitlements for blocked egress and mirrored OCI registry. Owner: Daniel. Due: 2025-02-28.
2) HSM/KMS integration runbook prototype (work with security). Owner: Lucia. Due: 2025-03-03.
3) Small canary deployment with Mistral-7B-quantized artifact + perf runbook (latency/throughput benchmarks and profiling). Owner: Aisha. Target: 2025-03-10.
4) Redaction & audit example: pipeline demo for streaming redaction vs stored logs. Owner: Priya. Target: 2025-03-05.
5) Compliance note: confirm control-plane residency semantics with legal (is management metadata considered customer data?). Owner: Aisha + Legal. Target: 2025-02-25.

Open questions to resolve (short list):
- Exact embedding dimensionality and whether they need multiple embeddings per record (NLP + metadata embeddings).
- Do they require model weights never leave onprem (yes) vs mirrored registry allowed internally? Clarify.
- Which HSM interface — PKCS#11 or vendor-specific? Request sample certs/endpoint.
- SSO provisioning flow: need SAML IdP metadata and SCIM scope.
- Failure modes: what is acceptable fallback behavior if local nodes degrade (route to Hosted backup? they likely will not allow). Need ask: do they allow fallback to a Redwood-hosted private region under contract?

Notes-to-self / shorthand (messy):
- ask infra about adding "local-oci-proxy" example for air-gapped pulls.
- perf: run p99 baseline with seq len 512 and measure kv cache effectiveness. kv cache warmup critical for chat p99.
- cost talk: show dedicated vs private pricing — emphasize unit economics with batching + quantization.

Immediate next steps (post-call):
- Email recap + attach quick checklist + request SAML metadata, HSM spec, sample embedding CSV. (Aisha, today 02/18)
- Spin up internal thread with Security (Lucia) + Infra (Daniel) + Product (Priya) w/ JIRA-4827 link.
- Prepare 1-page POC plan with milestones and minimal acceptance criteria (low-latency chat p99 < 1200ms; nightly embedding completion < 4 hours). Due 02/21.

Useful links / artifacts to attach in next email:
- Onprem quickstart (confluence) — link to be added
- Example Helm + systemd bootstrap snippets (git repo link in linked_artifacts)
- JIRA-4827 (HSM integration)

End notes (voice-of-customer):
- "We can't have data leak — even telemetry headers. If we can't guarantee, we won't proceed." -> emphasize audit and redaction.
- They are cost-sensitive; pushing for small quantized models for both chat and embeddings to keep infra small.

Scratch: random jots that came up on the call:
- ask sales to confirm their procurement lead + contract timeline (Q2 renewals?)
- bring up that Dedicated offering probably won't meet their no-egress rule unless paired with Private control plane replica.
- check if customer already uses Vault for secrets; might simplify KMS integration.
